text:
eric: Quick design huddle. Were getting conflicting asks: low-latency prompt path vs rich message model for tool-calls. Need scoping decision for the roadmap.

tara: My recommendation: canonicalize on messages (array) with explicit role enum {system,user,assistant}. Provide a compact opt-in path: POST /v1/compact-completions with a single string body.

miguel: If we add a separate endpoint for compact, ops can optimize it differently. But more surface area to maintain. Maybe prefer header-based opt-in for now: X-Redwood-Mode: compact.

qa-bot: noted: potential QA concerns - compact mode must have clear test matrix: tool-invocation, structured-output, streaming parity.

priya: For the official launch checklist propose:
1) Final message JSON schema (role, content, metadata)
2) SDK helpers + migration samples
3) Backwards-compat compatibility guide and compact-mode warning doc
4) Canary rollout + per-account flag
5) Telemetry for tool-call loss-rate and role-violation rate
6) Cost examples and token-accounting doc
7) Beta cohort and deprecation timeline for raw prompt endpoint
eric: Agree. Prioritization: 1-4 must for beta. 5-7 should be live by GA. Resource estimate: infra ~2 sprints, SDKs ~1 sprint, docs ~0.5 sprint.

tara: We also need to decide on system role enforcement. Suggest soft-warn for 72 hours then reject duplicates, unless using system_blocks field. Also add a "role_intent" metadata key for system messages to aid routing.

miguel: For the compact mode, clarify well not try to synthesize tool hints; compact = best-effort only. Add deprecation header if compact client is detected and missing critical metadata.

priya: action items: tara -> draft schema + examples by Wed; eric -> create beta plan + cohort list by Fri; miguel -> infra effort estimate + flag plan by Wed. QA -> test plan by Thu. 30m review Friday. If no blockers we target beta in 3 sprints. :thumbsup:
